name: pmm-instinct-review
description: Capture eligible Codex or Claude sessions, extract durable candidates with an explicit configured model, and promote only human-approved guidance to exact validated targets.

interface.longDescription: Capture eligible Codex sessions only after an exact extractor model is configured, resolve adopter-owned RUN and REF routes without guessing, or use the unchanged self-contained native Claude runtime. No candidate or promotion is approved automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use $pmm-instinct-review to show continuous learning status.

Use $pmm-instinct-review to show validated RUN or REF promotion targets without choosing for me.
Use $pmm-instinct-review to show native Claude capture and extraction status.
